unlocks.summary: Locked ONDO is released 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60 months after the January 18, 2024 unlock, so the next release is January 18, 2027. Ondo doesn't publish the size of each release.

events.label: 36-month release of locked ONDO
events.basis: The proposal schedules releases 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60 months after the initial unlock. The docs say transfers opened on January 18, 2024 once FIP-08 passed, with seed and Series A investors on a one-year lock then a 48-month release, and the core team on a five-year lock-up. Neither page gives the size of each release.

source.label: Ondo Foundation blog: Unlocking ONDO (the FIP-08 proposal)

token.name: Ondo
token.description: The Ondo Foundation was founded in 2022 as an independently governed and nonprofit Cayman Islands Foundation Company with no beneficial owners. The Ondo Foundation assisted in the launch of the Ondo DAO, which deployed and currently governs Flux Finance, the first lending protocol supporting tokenized securities as collateral.
